lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Tarek, wait — that pitch about the delivery app? That was mine. I mean, I wrote that last week.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Relax, Macal. It's a networking event. Ideas float around. Nobody owns a conversation.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: He just told the whole room it was his idea. And the investor believed him.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: If I don't say something right now, I've already lost. I'm going in.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أَهْلًا بِيكُم يا جَماعَة فِي يَلّا فْلُوَنْت! أَنا مَحْمُود، وَالنَّهارْدَه مَعانا مَشْهَد مِنْ حَياة ماكال فِي دُبَيّ... اْجْتِماع نِتْوَرْكِينْج، وَالْكَلِمْ ماشْي بِالسِّرْعَة!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: ماكال عايِز يِدْخُل جُوَّه الكلامْ... ويِقُول رَأْيُه مِنْ غِير ما يِتْلَخْبَط. وَبِسْ... تارِك سَبَقُه وَخَدْ الفِكْرَة لِحْسابُه!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: النَّهارْدَه هِنْسْمَع تَلاتَه عِباراتْ حِلْوِين: عِبارَة تِفْتَح بِها الكَلامْ، وَعِبارَة تِدْخُل بِها عَلى جَماعَة بِتِتْكَلِّم... وَعِبارَة تِلْحَق بِها بَعْدِين، يَعْنِي الفُولُو أَبْ.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: يَلّا... سَمِّع كوَيِّس، وَخُد بِالكْ مِنْ كِلْ مِثالْ!

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Excuse me — sorry to cut in. I couldn't help overhearing. You were talking about the delivery app for small shops, right?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Tarek was just telling us how it works. Are you in this space too?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Actually, I've been working on something similar for months. The idea is to help shops that don't have their own app yet. I mean... it's not just delivery. It's a full system.
lines.direction: finding his footing, then gaining momentum

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Interesting. Macal and I work at the same company. We bounce ideas off each other all the time. Right, Macal?

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Sure. But this one came from my notebook, not a chat. I can walk you through the numbers if you have five minutes.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Five minutes? I like the confidence. Go ahead, walk me through it.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: There you are! I've been looking everywhere. Oh — you're already deep in it. Good.
lines.direction: warm, quick, supportive, slipping into the group easily

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Nour, this is — sorry, I didn't catch your name. We were just getting into the details.
lines.direction: light, natural, covering the social gap

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Faisal. Faisal from Gulf Ventures. And honestly, Macal — you should send me a follow-up this week. Let's talk properly.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Great. I'll make sure he follows up. We can come together — one team, one pitch.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: I'll follow up myself, Faisal. I live here since two years, this city is my home now. I won't let this idea stay in a notebook.
lines.direction: assertive, planting his flag, slight emotional crack

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب، خُد بِالكْ... ماكال قال: "I live here since two years." دِي غَلْطَة صَغِيرَة، وَبِتْحْصَل عَشان فِي العَرَبِي بِنْقُول "أَنا عايِش هِنا مِنْ سَنِتَيْن"... فَالعَقِل بِيْحَوِّلْها حَرْفِي. بَسْ الإِنْجِلِيزِي بِتَحِبْ present perfect مَعَ since... فَالأَصَح: "I've lived here for two years."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: أُول عِبارَة، عِبارَة تِفْتَح بِها الكَلامْ: "I couldn't help overhearing." يَعْنِي "مَعْلِش، سِمِعْت نُصّ الكَلامْ وَما قْدِرْتِش أَمْنَع نَفْسِي." بِتْقُولَها لَمّا تِيجِي تِدْخُل عَلى جَماعَة... زَيّ: "I couldn't help overhearing — is this about the delivery app?"

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تَانِي عِبارَة، عِبارَة تِدْخُل بِها عَلى جَماعَة بِتِتْكَلِّم: "Sorry to cut in." يَعْنِي أَسْفَه إِنِّي قَطَعْت الكَلامْ... بَسْ بِتَقُولَها بِأَدَبْ وَثِقَة. مِثال: "Sorry to cut in — but I've been working on this for months."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: تالِت عِبارَة، الفُولُو أَبْ: "I'll follow up myself." يَعْنِي هَتْكَلِّم أَنا بِنَفْسِي، مُش حَدْ تانِي هَيِكَلِّم عَنِّي. دِي قَوِيَّة جِدًّا فِي الشُّغِل... بَتْوَرِّي إِنَّك صاحِب الفِكْرَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَأْتِي... الأَكْسَنْت لاب! النَّهارْدَه عَلى نُطْق /ŋ/... يَعْنِي آخِر الكَلْمَة اللي بِتْخَلِّص بـ -ing. ما تْقُولِش "walkin"... وَما تْقُولِش "walkeen"... الصَّوْت مِنْ وَرَا اللِّسَانْ، مَرَّة وَاحْدَة. جَرِّب: "talking"... "working"... "walking." كَرَّر وَرَايَا!

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: شَاطِر! اسْمَع الفَرْق... "talkin" — غَلَط. "talking" — صَح. مَرَّة تانِي: "I've been working on something similar." يَلّا، كَرِّر الجُمْلَة كامْلة، وَوَرِّيني!

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Alright, Macal. I've seen a lot of pitches. Yours has something — a real problem, a real system. Send me the follow-up, and I'll read it properly.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Thank you, Faisal. I've lived here for two years, and I've seen these shops struggle every day. This isn't just an idea for me — it's my neighborhood.

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: That was smooth. You didn't freeze, you didn't let Tarek take the wheel. I'm actually impressed.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Honestly? My heart was going like a drum. But I couldn't help overhearing him, and I just... I had to say something.

lines.speaker: Tarek
lines.text: Nice work, Macal. Really. But Faisal meets a lot of people. Don't get your hopes too high — it's a long road.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Maybe. But I'll follow up myself. That part isn't up to anyone else.
lines.direction: calm, firm, not rising to it

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: Macal — hold on. My boss just texted me. She's here tonight, and she wants to meet the guy with the delivery idea.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Wait — your boss? The one who runs Rising Voices? Nour, I'm not ready. I mean... what do I even say?

lines.speaker: Nour
lines.text: You say what you just said to Faisal. Come on — she's by the window, and she's already looking this way.

lines.speaker: Macal
lines.text: Okay. Okay. One pitch. I've been working for this my whole life — I'm not running now.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: طَيِّب يا جَماعَة... إحْنا وَصَلْنا لآخِر المَشْهَدْ! النَّهارْدَه اتْعَلَّمْنا تَلاتَة عِبارات، تِفْتَح بِها أَي كَلامْ: "I couldn't help overhearing"... "Sorry to cut in"... وَ"I'll follow up myself." دُوُل مُفْتاحَك عَشان تِدْخُل عَلى أَي جَماعَة، وَتَوَرِّي إِنَّك صاحِب الفِكْرَة.

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَعَلى فِكْرَة... نُطْق /ŋ/ النَّهارْدَه كَمان! "talking"... "working"... "walking." الصَّوْت مِنْ وَرَا اللِّسَانْ، مَرَّة وَاحْدَة، مُش "talkin" وَمُش "walkeen."

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: وَدِلْوَأْتِي... عِبارَة الحَلْقَة. أَنا اخْتَرْت: "I'll follow up myself." لِيه؟ عَشان دِي عِبارَة المَسْؤُولِيَّة... بَتْقُول: أَنا هَعْمِل كِدَه بِنَفْسِي، مُش هَسْتَنَّى حَدْ. دِي عِبارَة تِخَلِّيك واقِف عَلى رِجْلِيك.
lines.direction: proud, clear, slow on the phrase

lines.speaker: Coach
lines.text: بَسْ أَنا عايِز أَسْمَعَك! سَجِّل فُويس نُوت صَغِير... قُول فِيه: "I'll follow up myself"... وَخَلِّي بالَك مِنْ نُطْقك، وَرِيّنا أَكْسَنْتِك. وَابْعَتْها عَلى تِلِجْرام... عَلى جَماعَة Empire English Community. إحْنا مُسْتَنيين سَمَاعَك، وَهَنِشَجَّعَك، أَصْلًا إِنْتَ مُش لَوَحْدَك فِي الحِكايَة!
lines.direction: inviting, encouraging, community warmth, big energy

phrase_of_episode.ar: هَتْكَلِّم أَنا بِنَفْسِي، مُش حَدْ تانِي هَيِكَلِّم عَنِّي

phonetic_focus.note: The '-ing' ending is one nasal sound made at the back: 'walking', not 'walkin' and not 'walkeen'. Don't add a hard G or an extra vowel.
